title: Block Orientation Texture Indicator
description: Shows texture flip & rotation of some blocks at different coordinates.
body:
# Overview
This lightweight utility resource pack helps you quickly tell the texture flip and rotation state of basic blocks in vanilla Minecraft.

It adds intuitive visual markers to these blocks:
- Dirt, Sand, Grass Block, Stone, Dirt Path, Netherrack, Sculk, Bedrock, Podzol, Mycelium, Rooted Dirt
- Deepslate, Froglights
- All types of Concrete Powder

With these markers, you can easily distinguish texture changes caused by different positions. Besides, exclusive directional cues are added to deepslate, making deepslate orientation and flip state recognizable at a glance.

# Core Features
1. Visualize texture flip & rotation differences of some blocks
2. Special orientation indicators for deepslate block
3. Texture-only modification, no changes to game mechanics, items or models
4. Negligible performance overhead, no frame drops
5. Compatible with most other texture packs, fully works with vanilla
6. No mod loaders (Fabric / Forge / OptiFine) required

# Compatibility
- Game: Minecraft Java Edition
- Supported Versions: Fill your target versions here
- Dependencies: None

# Notice
This is a Beta version. Most of bugs will fix in future updates.

All gallery screenshots utilize external shaders for demonstration; all shaders are property of their respective creators.
